paper.title_en: The nucleon structure from an AdS/QCD model in the Veneziano limit
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the internal structure of the proton using the holographic VQCD model, which incorporates quark flavor effects and dynamically reproduces key QCD features such as confinement and linear mass spectra. Under this framework, we first compute the proton mass spectrum and corresponding wave functions, refined by including anomalous dimension corrections. Wethen evaluate proton structure functions at large Bjorken-𝑥 using a consistent set of parameters.Moreover, we derive the electromagnetic form factor of the proton by solving the equation ofmotion for the gauge field in a curved background, and show that it qualitatively aligns with resultsfrom fermion-coupled Maxwell theory. Finally, we calculate the gravitational form factors by introducing an effective graviton mass 𝑚 induced by the energy-momentum tensor of the proton andchiral symmetry breaking. Our results show remarkable consistency with available experimentaldata and lattice QCD simulations, demonstrating the HVQCD model as a reliable approach forstudying non-perturbative nucleon properties
